description: For products with needs_inquiry (bills, e-wallet top-ups): look up the customer name and amount the buyer must confirm. Rate-limited like the web form and may cost the platform an upstream lookup, so call it once per request and only after the buyer gave the destination. Returns an inquiry_id for prepare_purchase; the lookup result is stored server-side, never trust or resend raw data.
name: inquire_purchase
title: Cek tagihan atau tujuan
